what: Speech-bubble text grows like human typing, 1–6 characters at once every 200ms beat — 8% of the time it deletes a character and retypes it, 12% of the time it hesitates for a beat. It uses seeded random, so the tempo is the same every time it opens. A word written as ‹final|reading› shows the reading (kana) fully typed, then swaps to the final text (kanji) in a single beat, like an input-method conversion.

options.burst: Maximum characters that can be painted per beat, default 6 (original Japanese 6 · English 8 · AI mascot +2)
options.seed: Random seed, default 7 — give each line a different one to split the tempo
options.slips: If false, turns off erase-and-retype (the original AI mascot lines are typed without mistakes)
options.on: view (when it rises above the bottom 15% of the screen, default) · load (immediately) · manual (waits for fx:play)
options.again: After finishing, rest this many seconds then start again from the beginning — if omitted, plays once
options.data-text: Element attribute — write the text to type, split by spaces, in the type ‹final|reading› (if absent, the element text as is)
options.fx:play: Sending to the element retypes it from the start · emits fx:typed when done

use: Your speech bubble line here

from.where: index.js hero app window — in each room, human and AI chat bubbles are typed a few characters at a time on a 200ms beat (original module 9593 uG, beat 200ms)
